disagreements.title: 9 colour tokens share only 4 distinct value(s) in light mode
disagreements.detail:
49 colour token(s) resolve to 44 distinct light value(s). Where two names always carry the same value, a reader cannot tell which one a screen should use:
- #ffffff: --ifm-background-color, --ifm-card-background-color
- 210 40% 96.1%: --muted, --panel, --accent
- #6366f1: --ifm-color-primary, --ifm-menu-color-active
- #e5e7eb: --docs-color-border, --ifm-toc-border-color

disagreements.title: 2 colour token(s) have no dark value
disagreements.detail: They keep their light value in dark mode: --ifm-alert-border-left-width, --ifm-toc-border-color.

disagreements.detail: No utility class and no `var()` reference spends them: --ifm-alert-background-color, --ifm-card-background-color, --ifm-navbar-background-color, --docusaurus-highlighted-code-line-bg, --ifm-color-primary-dark, --ifm-color-primary-darker, --ifm-color-primary-darkest, --ifm-color-primary-light, --ifm-color-primary-lighter, --ifm-color-primary-lightest, --ifm-alert-border-left-width, --ifm-toc-border-color, --ifm-font-color-base, --ifm-font-family-base, --ifm-font-family-monospace, --ifm-font-size-base, --ifm-alert-border-radius, --ifm-global-radius, --doc-sidebar-width, --ifm-alert-padding-horizontal, --ifm-alert-padding-vertical, --ifm-line-height-base, --ifm-navbar-height, --ifm-navbar-padding-horizontal, --ifm-navbar-padding-vertical, --ifm-spacing-horizontal, --ifm-navbar-shadow, borderWidth.hairline, --ifm-heading-color, --ifm-menu-color-active, --ifm-menu-color.
